mapper.insert: insert into rabbit_abnormal_conditions (rabbit_id, house_id, warning_status, warning_time, img_url, remark, is_deal, create_by, update_by) values (#{rabbitId}, #{houseId}, #{warningStatus}, #{warningTime}, #{imgUrl}, #{remark}, #{isDeal}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.update: update rabbit_abnormal_conditions set is_deal = #{deal}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and house_id = #{houseId}
mapper.select: select a.* from rabbit_abnormal_conditions a join rabbits r on r.id = a.rabbit_id and r.house_id = a.house_id where a.house_id = #{houseId} and r.cage_id = #{cageId} order by a.warning_time desc, a.id desc limit 1
